name: herdr-bridge
description: Tells herdr what Claude Code is doing and asking: the prompt as the pane's title, the question or permission it waits on, and a summary of each turn

mode.title: Report mode
mode.description: metadata: change only what herdr shows (title, labels, summary), beside herdr's own Claude integration. state: also report working/blocked/idle from the exact events, so herdr's waits and notifications follow them

text.title: Text sent to herdr
text.description: full: the prompt, the question and the command waited on. labels: only generic labels ("waiting on a question"), no text from the session
